Hand-written 2026-09-24 because `npm run new` is broken in this container (HANDOVER.md). www.prostylebuilding.com.au no longer resolves; prostylebuilding.com.au 301-redirects to https://www.prostylehomes.com.au/, which I read in full with curl. Same business as Google's 'Prostyle Homes': same phone (02) 6282 0770, which is the number on their own site, and the Google reviews name Josh and Craig, who are named on the site. Google rating 3.5 from 19 is below the 4.7 floor, so no rating shows. Reviews are the six best_for_demo quotes, word for word, each shown once (no pull quote). The builders preset's process, FAQ and responsePromise would be invented claims here, so all three are overridden with ProStyle's own published wording. See BRIEF.md for the identity check, entity change and photo inventory.

services.title: New homes
services.blurb: We work with your architect or designer on a home that's modern, functional and personal to you. The final calls on finishes and fittings are yours, and our construction team looks after the build.

process.detail: Book a time with us. Tell us what you want to build or change, where, and whether you already have an architect or designer.
Our project managers work with your architect or designer, and help with the working drawings and approvals.
A dedicated construction manager runs the programme. You get regular site meetings and a progress report every week.
When it's done, we hand the keys back and you get to enjoy the look and feel of the finished home.

reviews.name: Julian Barnard
reviews.text: Prostyle completed our renovations efficiently and to a high standard. Josh provided excellent project management and was always available to answer our questions. The tradesmen were reliable and happy to accommodate our personal requests. I would highly recommend this company to complete home renovations.

reviews.name: Alexander Claudianos
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience building our home with Prostyle Building Group here in Canberra, and Craig in particular went above and beyond throughout the entire build.

reviews.name: Jabs Dheadfactor
reviews.text: Extremely profession experience. We worked directly with Josh and he was amazing. The extension was everything we could ask for and then some. Would highly recommend and even when their were problems, they were quickly resolved.

reviews.name: Stuart Turner
reviews.text: We found Joshua and the team at Prostyle to be extremely professional and knowledgeable in all aspects of our renovation. They listened to us, gave us what we wanted and delivered the work to a high standard.

reviews.name: Ella Edwards
reviews.text: I highly recommend Prostyle Building – professional, experienced, responsive, efficient and friendly. Prostlye finished on time and on budget with quality workmanship and attention to detail.

reviews.name: Dave & Evina C
reviews.text: Prostyle Building Group and the subcontractors they utilize are the best in the business. Josh Fogg and his team did an amazing job in transforming our town house both inside and out.

faq.q: Can you work with our own architect?
faq.a: Yes. Our project managers and builders work with your architect or designer. We can also help from the design stage through working drawings and approvals.

faq.q: How will we know how the build is going?
faq.a: Your dedicated construction manager runs the programme and keeps you updated, with regular site meetings and a progress report every week.

faq.q: Can we live at home during a renovation?
faq.a: Clients have lived on site through major renovations with us. We keep the site clean and safe the whole way through.

faq.q: Will an extension look tacked on?
faq.a: It shouldn't. We finish the outside to flow with your existing house, so it looks sharp and fresh rather than added-on. And we build to current building and energy requirements.

Yes, in established suburbs and on new blocks. We can run feasibility studies, handle consultation with neighbours, and look after the planning, documentation and lodgement of plans with the authorities.
